strings.login.title: Idea box

strings.login.pseudo1: On first sign-in each demo account receives a pseudonym, for example “Idee-Fuchs-4821”. Ideas, votes and comments appear only under that name.
strings.login.pseudo2: In the real version the link between pseudonym and person is kept separately by a trusted office and is used only to pay a bonus. Idea management cannot see it.

strings.submit.title: Submit an idea
strings.submit.lede: Describe the idea so another profession can understand it. Similar ideas in the same language appear while you type. You can support or add a note instead of creating a new one.
strings.submit.titlePh: For example: standard sets in theatre
strings.submit.descPh: What is it about and what would change? No names, no patient data.
strings.submit.summary: Short summary in German (if you can)
strings.submit.summaryPh: One or two sentences in German
strings.submit.summaryHint: Optional. Moderation can add a German translation later. No external translation service is called.
strings.submit.similarWait: Similar ideas appear once the title or description is substantial. Only the same language is compared.
strings.submit.similarNone: No similar idea in this language. You can submit a new one.
strings.submit.savingsHint: A rough range is enough. Leave empty if you cannot estimate. This is not an audited figure.
strings.submit.voluntaryHint: We only ask for broad groups, not a single ward or department. That way nobody can be tied to a small unit. These details never appear on the idea or the pseudonym, only in the admin report, and only from 5 entries. There are no cross-tables. The default is “prefer not to say”.
strings.submit.fresh: Use a new pseudonym for this idea
strings.submit.freshHint: Then nobody can link several of your ideas through the same pseudonym. You still see them under My ideas, because the link stays only in this browser.
strings.mod.title: Moderation
strings.mod.premod: Review new comments before they are public
strings.mod.hint: The aim is a reply within 30 days. A decline needs a factual reason. The thank-you text is added automatically. In the prototype every status can be chosen directly.
strings.mod.empty: There are no ideas in your areas.
strings.mod.pick: Choose an idea from the list.
strings.mod.path: Path: submitted, in review, accepted, implemented, declined or merged.
strings.mod.areaHint: If you change the area, the idea then belongs to that area's moderation.
strings.mod.thanks: Thank you for your idea and the time you took for it.
strings.mod.thanksHint: This thank-you is placed before the reason. The reason stays factual and names no one.
strings.mod.translationHint: Shown on the idea page as “Translation by moderation”. No external service.
strings.stats.title: Reports
strings.stats.lede: Only for idea management. All euro amounts are demo data. Estimates are midpoints of the ranges and are not audited. Merged duplicates are not included in the totals.
strings.stats.demoHint: Groups under 5 are shown as “<5”. If a single value could be calculated from the total, another group is hidden as well. There are no cross-tables of several attributes. The hatching does not encode a size.

strings.help.title: How it works and privacy
strings.help.purpose.title: What the idea box is for
strings.help.purpose.body: Staff of every profession can submit ideas, especially on savings and simpler work. From 1 January 2027 the group must work noticeably more economically. The box collects ideas from Landshut-Mitte, Achdorf, Rottenburg and the children's hospital.
strings.help.proto.title: This is a prototype
strings.help.proto.body: There is no server. Everything stays in this browser and is marked as demo data. Please do not enter real ideas or personal data. The hospital group is a scenario for this demonstration, and the examples are invented.
strings.help.login.title: Sign-in
strings.help.login.body: You sign in with a demo account: mitarbeiter, moderation or admin, password Ideenbox-LA. This protects nothing. In the real version there is only the hospital login, with no extra password in the idea box.
strings.help.pseudo.title: Pseudonyms
strings.help.pseudo.body: Ideas, support and comments appear only under a pseudonym. The prepared demo accounts have a fixed example pseudonym so My ideas is visible at once. For a single idea you can choose a new pseudonym so several ideas are not linked by the same name. The link stays only in this browser. In the real version a trusted office stores it apart from the ideas, and only to pay a bonus.
strings.help.who.title: Who sees what
strings.help.who.body: Everyone signed in sees ideas, status, the reply thread and comments with a pseudonym. The official reply is marked as such and names the function, for example “Area Purchasing”, not a person. Moderators handle ideas in their areas. Idea management sees all areas and the reports. Nobody sees the voluntary statistics on a single idea.
strings.help.sparse.title: Data minimisation
strings.help.sparse.body: Profession, age group, tenure, gender and home area are voluntary, default to “prefer not to say”, and stay broad. No ward, no department. A group is shown only from 5 entries, otherwise “<5”. If one value could be calculated from the total, another group is hidden. There are no cross-tables.
strings.help.dup.title: Duplicate ideas
strings.help.dup.body: While you type, the box shows similar ideas in the same language. You can support an existing idea or add a note. Moderators can merge duplicates. The duplicate points to the main idea.
strings.help.sla.title: A reply within 30 days
strings.help.sla.body: The aim is a reply within 30 days. While an idea is submitted or in review and has no reply yet, it shows “Reply due in X days” or “overdue”.
strings.help.status.title: Status
strings.help.status.body: Submitted, in review, accepted, implemented, declined with a factual reason and a thank-you, or merged with a link to the main idea.
strings.help.protect.title: How you are protected
strings.help.protect.body: Nobody should be confronted or shamed because of an idea. The official reply names a function, not a person. Comments use a pseudonym. Before the first comment you confirm the rules: factual, respectful, no names. Hurtful words raise a warning and are not stored. If a text names a person, you see “Please do not name people”. Comments can be reported and hidden by moderation. Idea management can require review before comments are public. An idea can use a fresh pseudonym.
strings.help.answers.title: Where you find replies
strings.help.answers.body: Every idea has its own page with a reply thread: the official moderation reply at the top, then comments from other staff under a pseudonym. Under My ideas you only see your own ideas. When a new reply arrives, a badge appears. This works only through the pseudonym, with no name and no email.
strings.help.prize.title: Bonus idea
strings.help.prize.body: The proposal is to reward implemented ideas with a share of the saving proven in the first year. Amount and cap are set by management and the staff council. Payment would go through the trusted office. Idea management would still not learn which person is behind the pseudonym.
strings.help.next.title: Path to real use
strings.help.next.body: German hosting, hospital login, involvement of the data protection officer and the staff council, separate stores for ideas and for the identity link. A German translation could later be done by a service hosted in Germany or the EU. The prototype calls no such service. Details are in the README.
strings.savings.heading: Why we need to save
strings.savings.intro: The text explains in plain language why the group must save. You can choose the language of the text. The page can be read without signing in.
